sentences.text: 2.  The crime has been registered against applicant and other vide Crime No.293/2022, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 120-A, 120- B, 191, 192, 193, 415, 425, 426, 464, 468 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The applicant was serving as a Sarpanch of village Hirvad, Tah. Lonar, Dist. Buldhana, during the period from 22.12.2017 to 08.09.2020.

By and large, it is alleged that applicant while acting as a Sarpanch misappropriated the huge Government funds meant for different type of schemes and thus, Prity 2/2 8.apl257.2023 committed aforesaid offence.

Initially, the informant has applied to the police but cognizance was not taken i.e. why he filed application in terms of Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, in which directions has been issued for registration of FIR.
The informant is a villager who has filed the report.
It is primely contended that applicant being a public servant, without obtaining requisite sanction in terms of Section 197, the prosecution is not tenable.
As final report cannot be filed without sanction.
It has been submitted that the allegations does not make out a specific offence against the applicant.
